scope: Extend the existing reusable unprivileged actual-body microtest profile to the isolated fork-adoption source root and named test/helper/templates. Command, privilege, tool, resource and side-effect classes remain unchanged. Candidate semantics and unsafe/native integration are not approved here.

source_root.repository_access: Read-only during each reviewed test; preserve existing isolated production/test WIP. This is approved trusted command behavior, not an enforced read-only filesystem sandbox.

inspection.entrypoint: Read the complete new driver. It reads exact local production/test sources, invokes one existing extraction helper and creates one retained mkdtemp output root. Only pinned rustc --version, the existing --edition=2021 --test -Dwarnings compiler family and the resulting fixture --test-threads=1 are invoked, sequentially.
inspection.transitive_repository_imports: The sole repository import is fixture_source from test_native_fork_ownership_20261017.py. Read its complete changed driver and boundary template. Imports otherwise use Python standard libraries and have no compiler, host-state, root, Docker or network side effects.
inspection.generated_fixture: Read both complete templates and each extracted production VMA owner/open/close, mmap, lookup_fault, worker and fork-adoption transition body. Generated fixture contains deterministic local test values and ordinary in-process Arc/RefCell/atomic-free state adapters, with no external side effects or hardware access.
inspection.oracle_scope: The original four negative/control boundary tests remain in the generated fixture, with eight additional bootstrap/adoption failure/order tests declared. Their execution and semantic coverage are not claimed by this profile review.
inspection.fork_gate: Read non-null CREATE_PPD rejection in unchanged mcctrl_process.rs. The test asserts the rejection remains present; this profile does not enable the production fork gate.
inspection.retention: The retained mkdtemp source/binary root is never automatically deleted by the admitted driver. Commands, compiler version, compile/run stdout/stderr and return statuses are saved before assertions. Timeout streams and explicit timeout status are saved. TMPDIR must be supplied under the fresh dispatcher-owned evidence root.

commands.legacy_driver: The same admitted command family may run scripts.tests.test_native_fork_ownership_20261017 in this source root.
commands.version: Pinned rustc --version; no toolchain installation or fallback.
commands.environment: env -i with PATH=/usr/bin:/bin, LC_ALL=C, LANG=C, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, MCKERNEL_RUSTC_1_92 set to the existing pinned compiler and HOME/TMPDIR under one fresh private dispatcher evidence root. Clear credentials, SUDO_ASKPASS, loader/Python/compiler overrides; no source-root writes.
commands.outer_bounds: taskset CPU7, inherited reviewed prlimit and outer timeout 180 seconds plus at most five seconds cleanup of only the owned process group.

resources.aggregate: Deduct one CPU/2 GiB from the existing shared campaign budget. This extends the root/entrypoint envelope, not the number of reserved jobs or heavy leases. Dispatcher schedules this compiler before the heavy build under the current instruction.
resources.limits_caveat: Per-process AS/CPU/file-size limits are not aggregate quotas. The eight-process bound is assured by the reviewed serial subprocess family, not RLIMIT_NPROC for the shared user. Preserve original capacity floors and retain all failed materializations/results.

change_envelope: Reuse for changed candidate production bytes and routine vectors within this same extracted-body/test family, with fresh hashes/results and unchanged independent expectations. Dispatcher inspects each changed entrypoint/helper/generated side-effect boundary. No fresh review per routine vector; changes to commands, dependencies, privilege, isolation, resource use or side effects require renewed review.
